blocks.text: THE HAGUE, Netherlands — Former Philippine president Rodrigo Duterte stands trial from Monday at the International Criminal Court in arguably the highest-profile case in the institution’s 24-year history. Duterte is the first Asian former head of state to appear at the ICC and his trial comes as the court faces unprecedented global pressure, including sweeping sanctions from the United States. Here are five key things to know about the blockbuster trial: What are the charges? Duterte faces three counts of crimes against humanity for indirectly co-conspiring to murder or attempt to murder alleged drug users or pushers during his so-called “war […]...
